_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-49, AUTOMATED HALF ONLY. FP-H is an anti-anchoring property of the SECOND review: it needs the manual fix commit plus the unrelated-file edit, and its assertion is the absence of round-1 framing on a file that has no error-handling code. Asserted here: round 1 produces the error-handling findings on src/worker.ts that the manual half depends on. Labelled `mechanical` (mergewatch.ai#660): any completed review posts the summary comment (postSummaryOnClean defaults to true; `stayingSilent`, review-agent.ts:1051) and renders a score badge (`formatReviewComment`, comment-formatter.ts:760), so a full-range score and a present comment hold for every model output.
